fields.description: Master switch. When OFF (default), the DPDP consent page is never shown and the system behaves exactly as it does today. Turn ON only for sites/projects that require the DPDP consent step.
fields.label: Enable DPDP Consent

fields.description: When enabled, the candidate must accept the DPDP consent before Employee Onboarding can be initiated for them. If unchecked, the consent page is shown for acknowledgement but does not block onboarding.
fields.label: Require Consent Before Onboarding

fields.description: Main heading of the consent page.
fields.label: Form Title

fields.description: Sub-heading shown under the title.
fields.label: Form Subtitle

fields.description: Where the candidate actually gives consent. Internal Form renders the page built from the content below (the original behaviour). External Portal hands the candidate over to the HPCP consent portal — the content below is then owned by that portal and only the credentials/endpoint section applies.
fields.label: Consent Mode

fields.description: Full URL of the partner consent start API. Called server-side once the candidate accepts the offer; its shortUrl is where the candidate is sent.
fields.label: Consent Start URL

fields.description: Basic-auth username (partner id) issued by the consent portal.
fields.label: Partner Username

fields.description: Basic-auth password issued by the consent portal. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Partner Password

fields.description: Sent as the orgId header on every call.
fields.label: Org ID

fields.description: Sent as configurationCode — selects which consent template the portal shows.
fields.label: Configuration Code

fields.description: How the portal sends the OTP to the candidate. EMAIL needs an email address on the Job Applicant; a 10-digit mobile number is required either way.
fields.label: Channel

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the consent-start API before giving up.
fields.label: Request Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: Give this URL to the consent-portal team. They POST the completed consent here and we record it.
fields.label: Our Callback URL (share with portal team)

fields.description: Header the portal must send the shared secret in. The callback is rejected without it.
fields.label: Callback Secret Header

fields.description: Shared secret the portal sends in the header above. Use Generate Callback Secret and share it with them over a secure channel. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Callback Secret

fields.description: Where the portal sends the candidate back to once consent is recorded. Relative paths are resolved against this site. Placeholders: {applicant}, {session}, {status}, {token}. Note: {token} is the candidate's signed offer token — including it hands that token to the consent portal, so use it only when the landing page genuinely needs to identify a not-logged-in candidate.
fields.label: Return URL Template

fields.description: Optional. Sent as secondaryUrl in the consent-start payload; the portal preserves it and echoes it back in the webhook. Leave blank if not needed.
fields.label: Secondary URL

fields.description: Fallback lifetime for a consent session when the portal's response carries no expiresAt. A live session is reused instead of starting a new one.
fields.label: Session Validity (minutes)

fields.description: Rich-text introduction shown above the information table.
fields.label: Introduction Content

fields.description: Header of the left column of the information table.
fields.label: Information Column Label

fields.description: Header of the right column of the information table.
fields.label: Purpose Column Label

fields.description: Each active row becomes one line of the "Information Collected / Purpose" table on the consent page.
fields.label: Information Clauses

fields.description: Rich-text content shown after the information table and before the declaration checkboxes.
fields.label: Closing Content

fields.description: Heading shown above the consent checkboxes.
fields.label: Declaration Heading

fields.description: When checked, the candidate cannot submit until every statement marked Mandatory is ticked.
fields.label: Require All Mandatory Statements

fields.description: Each active row becomes one consent checkbox on the page.
fields.label: Consent Statements

fields.description: Ask the candidate to type / confirm their name when accepting.
fields.label: Capture Employee Name

fields.description: Record the date/time of acceptance in the consent log.
fields.label: Capture Acceptance Date

fields.description: Optional short note shown next to the acceptance button (e.g. legal footer).
fields.label: Confirmation Note
